cohort: 80 pregnant women aged between 18-40, parity 1-4, gestational age between 37 weeks-40 weeks, who attended the antenatal clinic of the hospital and delivered by either vaginal route or caesarean section
finding: Pre-gestational weight was positively correlated with placental thickness and negatively correlated with placental diameter in normotensive pregnancies, while maternal height was negatively correlated with the number of maternal cotyledons.
